content.short: Wormhole provides bridges that connect blockchains, including Solana assets, for cross-chain interoperability.
content.description: Wormhole adopts a modular architecture designed to span multiple chains as its layered foundation. It functions as a bridge that connects Solana assets to other blockchains, a cross-chain concept commonly referred to as xChain. By design, Wormhole streamlines the development of tokens and decentralized applications that operate across a cross-chain framework, enabling higher interoperability and enhanced performance across ecosystems. The approach also supports cross-chain messaging and token transfers, empowering developers to build versatile apps with broader reach, robust security, and scalable deployment options.
